title: M, N, O
summary: Learn M, N, O, then practise with the keys you already know.
intro: Learn M, N, O, then practise with the keys you already know.

screens.text: Hold Shift with the little finger of your left hand and press m to type M. Release Shift before the next key.
screens.content: MMM MM MMMM fMf fMM ffMM fM MMf MMfM fMMM MMMf MfM

screens.text: Hold Shift with the little finger of your left hand and press n to type N. Release Shift before the next key.
screens.content: NNN NN jNNN NNNN Njj Nj jjNN NNNj jNj

screens.text: Hold Shift with the little finger of your left hand and press o to type O. Release Shift before the next key.
screens.content: OfO fOO fO OOO OOOO OO OfOO Off OOf

screens.text: Type each target carefully, then return to the home position before the next one.
